method.database: private disposable dbtest schema; NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS owner; FORCE RLS
method.fixture: one tenant, one project, 80 work leaves, scoped agent and person session; empty inbox pull
method.per_variant: 3 runs; 3 fresh backends/run; 30 mixed warm-up iterations/backend; 100 measured iterations/backend on each of 5 endpoints (900 samples/endpoint/variant)
method.session: JIT off, as db.Open in production; only one unretained pool slot so every request uses the sampled backend; 3 total app backends, independent fresh pool per run
method.memory: allocated PostgreSQL memory contexts (not RSS or cgroup anonymous memory); snapshot from the app backend itself using a database-local SECURITY DEFINER helper; one MATERIALIZED snapshot; classify plan subtrees first, CacheMemoryContext subtree excluding plans second, then other; omit SQL text and payloads
method.latency: HTTP client wall time through reading and closing the complete body; nearest-rank p50/p95; pooled 900 samples/endpoint and per-run 300-sample quantiles retained; mixed warm-up excluded
method.guard: every endpoint pooled p95 <= baseline*1.10; median of the three run p95 values also checked; no aggregate across endpoints
limitations: Representative CLI/API hot workflows; production traffic rank was not available and the production database was never accessed.
The 80-leaf fixture does not reproduce the production ~85 MiB/backend or production data volume.
Shared guarded laptop runner: three runs, order rotation, all raw samples retained; results are workload evidence, not a universal latency guarantee.
OPS must verify production steady-state database memory below 70% of its limit after coordinator deployment.

decision.reason: Every measured lower-memory alternative breaches the +10% pooled p95 limit on at least one endpoint versus its contemporaneous baseline. Retain the lowest-memory admissible tested configuration: today's default. Native pgx URL/keyword/service configuration remains available and is covered by a real-connection behavior test.
decision.scope: Measurement and config coverage are complete. Production memory remediation is not delivered; coordinator/LEAD chooses any broader design or changed latency tradeoff. No claim of the OPS <70% production check.
